added_failures_note: The reviewed manifest arms no baseline_suite and no after_suite, and the diff adds no product source and no test file, so no suite delta exists to take. Zero is recorded because the change cannot add a test failure: it edits nothing any test executes. This is an absence of arms, not a measured green suite.

artifact_verification.source_summary: 6123 live / 5203 accepted / 920 unaccepted sources, 116 exhausted names; source class sum 920 and name class sum 116 reconcile; 73 of 920 source members and 27 of 116 name members listed; per-accepted-name USD 0.2444 at 4.1 accepted per USD; spend USD 0

added_executable_assertions: sib-unaccepted-census-run.py:93 raises when a graph result exceeds the caller's cap; it can fire only above 20,000 rows, and the live read returns 6,123, so it did not fire.
sib-unaccepted-census-run.py:518 and :521 raise on a class outside the declared set; classify_source and classify_exhausted return only declared literals, so neither can fire.
sib-unaccepted-census-run.py:523 and :525 compare each class Counter's sum to len() of the same collection the Counter was built from, so both hold whatever the classifier does.

sib-unaccepted-census-run.py:526 raises on any source whose class does not satisfy the separately written predicate in check_class_invariants; this one can fail and did, 237 times, on the mutated classifier recorded in negative-control.log.
sib-unaccepted-census-run.py:354 and :356 raise on an empty read of either population, which guards against reporting an empty census from a failed query.
assertion_review.durability_limit: No test is committed and the node correctly declares that no test path exists; the guards live inside the script, so a change to the script can be made alongside a change to its own checker and the two can agree while both are wrong.
assertion_review.independent_controls: negative-control.log records a mutated classifier scoring every drafted/reviewed source below the floor and the invariant check refusing it with exit 1, which is a genuine falsification of the check. The plan's own stated control, a source planted outside every class, is not applicable to this design because classify_source ends in a catch-all return, and the substitute mutation does not exercise the reconciliation guard.

findings.text: blocking: class_record stores only `representative[:12]`, so the committed JSON carries 73 of the 920 source assignments and 27 of the 116 name assignments; the plan's measure requires each item to be recorded in exactly one class, and sib-full-dd-continuation must run the advanceable classes scoped by source, which this artifact cannot supply without re-running the script.

blocking: cost_basis asserts `cohort_rerun_measured: null` with the note that no cohort rerun has run, while docs/plans/sn-integrity-backlog.html §51 records sib-second-pass (job 1308283) naming 83 of 143 sources for USD 1.49; the done-when requires the expected cost to come from the measured per-name cost of the full run and the cohort reruns, and the available measured cohort figure (USD 0.01795 per named source) is omitted on a false premise.

non-blocking: the reconciliation guard `sum(source_classes.values()) != len(unaccepted)` compares a Counter incremented once per item in the same loop that builds `unaccepted`, so it is true for every possible classification and cannot fail; the JSON's reconciliation block presents it as the evidence that each item is in exactly one class, which the plan names as this census's negative control.

non-blocking: every `status == 'failed'` source whose reason is not a refusal family is classed attempt-capped, whether or not it reached the cap of 5; the artifact's own representatives carry attempts 3 and 4, and a failed row recording no reason at all lands in the same class, so the name asserts a cause the census never established.

non-blocking: classify_source re-implements the cause-precedence classifier owned by imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_source_bindings.py:2076 (classify_parked_source, with CAP_PARKED_DISPOSITIONS at :2050) for the same StandardNameSource population, duplicating it with a different vocabulary rather than wrapping or extending the owner; the owner's documented rule that a row recording nothing is its own class is contradicted here.
